scheme_name: Scheme For Soft Loan To The Grant-in-aid/ Non-grant In Aid Institutions For Maintenance And Upgradation Of Infrastructure Facilities
other_conditions: The institution must be an aided or non‑aided institution of higher learning, including those offering professional courses
The society that runs the institution must be registered under the Societies Registration Act
The institution must have been in operation for at least 10 years prior to the loan application date
The institution must have a minimum on‑campus student strength of 300
The average passing percentage for the last three years (out of the five years preceding the application) must be at least 60%

The institution must satisfy at least one of the following: be affiliated with Goa University, or be recognized by AICTE, MCI, ACI, DCI or any other statutory body of the Government of India or Government of Goa
benefits_summary: The loan is disbursed in three tranches – 50% on sanction, 40% after a utilization certificate, and the remaining 10% after project completion and occupancy certification.
